title: Triplet2Track: A Hierarchical System with Object-Centric Representations for Reliable Long-Horizon Manipulation
abstract: arXiv:2608.22800v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Ensuring reliability in uncertain environments remains difficult for long-horizon robotic manipulation. End-to-end VLA models are data-heavy and opaque, making diagnosis and verification difficult. Hierarchical pipelines are more interpretable, but their plans are often weakly grounded in observations, weakly aligned with low-level actions, and computed without online feedback, leading to open-loop behavior and hallucinations. To address these issues, we introduce the Triplet-to-Track System (TTS), a closed-loop long-horizon imitation learning system that uses human videos to reduce reliance on robot-collected data. TTS represents high-level subgoals as instance-grounded triplets, translates them into continuous track priors for execution, and monitors task progress from observations for online replanning. translated_title: 三元组到跟踪：一种以对象为中心表示的层级系统，用于可靠的长时程操作
translated_abstract: 在不确定环境中确保可靠性对于长时程机器人操作仍然具有挑战性。端到端的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型数据需求大且不透明，使得诊断和验证变得困难。层级流水线更具可解释性，但其计划往往在观测中缺乏强基础，与低级动作对齐较弱，且在没有在线反馈的情况下计算，导致开环行为和幻觉。为解决这些问题，我们引入了三元组到跟踪系统（TTS），这是一种闭环长时程模仿学习系统，利用人类视频来减少对机器人收集数据的依赖。TTS将高级子目标表示为实例锚定的三元组，将其转换为用于执行的连续跟踪先验，并从观测中监控任务进度以进行在线重规划。在多样化的真实世界长时程任务中，TTS实现了74.8%的平均成功率，并支持对象级和组合性泛化。
tldr: 本文提出了一种名为Triplet2Track的闭环层级系统，通过将高级子目标表示为实例锚定的三元组并转化为跟踪先验，结合在线重规划，在真实世界长时程操作任务中实现了74.8%的平均成功率，并显著减少了对机器人收集数据的依赖。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Triplet2Track, a closed-loop hierarchical system that represents high-level subgoals as instance-grounded triplets translated into track priors with online replanning, achieving a 74.8% average success rate in real-world long-horizon manipulation tasks while reducing reliance on robot-collected data.
